title: Limbus E.G.O Gift
description: Bring Limbus Company's E.G.O Gifts into Minecraft — 80+ accessories with unique effects, a gacha draw system, upgrade mechanics, and a resource pack
body:
# ✦ Limbus E.G.O Gifts
## Bring the Sinners' Power to Minecraft

> *"The light of dawn does not belong to those who sleep."*

Step into the world of **Limbus Company** — equip E.G.O Gifts, harness their power, and fight your way through any challenge. This plugin brings **80+ fully implemented accessories** straight from the game into Minecraft 1.21.4 (Paper), each with unique effects, lore, and a custom resource pack.

---

## ⚙️ How It Works

Every player has **5 accessory slots**. Equip up to 5 Gifts simultaneously — their effects all stack. Open your accessory panel anytime with `/accessories`.

Effects trigger at six different moments:

| Trigger | When |
|---|---|
| 🔄 Passive | Every second (20 ticks) |
| ⚔️ On Attack | When you strike a mob |
| 🛡️ On Damaged | When a mob hits you (melee) |
| 💥 On Any Damage | Any damage source (fall, fire, etc.) |
| 💀 On Kill | When you kill a mob |
| ☠️ On Death | When you die |

---

## 🎲 The Gacha System

Collect **Lunacy** — a custom Wither Rose currency — and spend **32 per draw** at an admin-configured Gacha Chest.

- **Odds:** Tier I / II / III each at 30%, Tier IV at 10%
- **Duplicate protection:** If you draw something you already own, you receive a **Vestige** upgrade material instead
- **Visual flair:** White particles on normal draws; golden END_ROD particles on Tier IV pulls

---

## 🏆 Tier System & Upgrades

Gifts are divided into **four tiers** of power:

| Tier | Count | Rarity |
|------|-------|--------|
| I | 9 | Common |
| II | 23 | Uncommon |
| III | 27 | Rare |
| IV | 21 | Epic |

Use **Vestiges** to upgrade any Gift up to **3 times**, scaling its effects:

| Level | Multiplier | Material |
|-------|-----------|----------|
| Lv.0 | ×1.0 | — |
| Lv.1 | ×1.25 | Dark / Faint / Twinkling / Brilliant Vestige |
| Lv.2 | ×1.50 | Same tier Vestige |
| Lv.3 | ×2.0 | Same tier Vestige |

Simply hold a Vestige and open your accessory panel — drag it onto the matching Gift to upgrade.

---

## ✨ Featured Gifts (a taste of 80+)

| Name | Tier | Effect |
|------|------|--------|
| 🌸 Flower Mound | IV | Passive regeneration — *"Who will bury me when I'm gone?"* |
| 🎭 Mask of the Parade | IV | Become invisible while sneaking |
| ❄️ Clear Mirror, Calm Water | IV | 20% chance to halve incoming damage |
| 🦴 Tangled Bones | II | Double damage to skeletons; 20% ignite chance |
| 🔥 Piece of a Torn Summer | IV | Fire/lava damage triggers Strength I for 5s |
| 🌿 Sour Liquor Aroma | III | Passively afflicts nearby enemies with Weakness I |
| 💀 Smoking Gunpowder | II | Explode on death — deal 8 damage to all nearby |
| 📖 Book of Vengeance | IV | Passive Regen I, but Slowness pulses every 30s |

*...and 72 more, all with lore, custom colors, and unique triggers.*

---

## 📖 Gift Catalog

Not sure what to collect? Run `/egogift category` to open the **read-only Gift Catalog** — browse all accessories organized by tier. No permissions required.

---

## 🔧 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/accessories` | Open your accessory panel | Everyone |
| `/egogift category` | Browse the gift catalog | Everyone |
| `/egogift reload` | Reload plugin data from disk | Admin / OP |
| `/getgift <id>` | Give yourself any gift | Admin / OP |
| `/getgift lunacy [amount]` | Receive Lunacy tokens | Admin / OP |
| `/getgift menu` | Get the panel opener item (kept on death) | Admin / OP |
| `/gachachest set` | Mark a chest as a Gacha Chest | Admin / OP |
| `/gachachest remove` | Remove Gacha Chest status | Admin / OP |

---

## 🎨 Custom Resource Pack

A dedicated resource pack gives every Gift its own unique model, automatically pushed to players on join. Refusing the pack will kick the player to ensure visual consistency.

**Resource Pack:** [Limbus_E.G.O_Gifts_plugin_ResourcePack](https://github.com/EvansGoethe/Limbus_E.G.O_Gifts_plugin_ResourcePack)

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Drop the `.jar` into your server's `plugins/` folder
2. Start the server — the resource pack is pushed automatically
3. Run `/getgift menu` to receive the panel opener (a Nether Star, **kept on death**)
4. Set up a Gacha Chest: place a chest, look at it, run `/gachachest set`
5. Distribute Lunacy with `/getgift lunacy <amount>` and let the draws begin

**Requirements:** Paper 1.21.4 · Java 21
